narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Five rebound and reb+ast unders on a 6-game Saturday; Boston and Philadelphia injury tags decide the night
narratives.briefing: It is a 6-game Saturday with an early first tip, and every prop on the card is an under on rebounds or reb+ast, all rated Consider except Kyle Kuzma, who is a Pass at conviction 44. The edge leans on the simulation, with Paul George under 5.5 rebounds the standout at 82% in sims against 47% at DraftKings. The record is mixed: morning picks are 7-8-0 (-1.78u), though closing lines have moved toward our morning picks 10 times and against them 4 times. Game lines remain leans only and are 15-33 (-19.57u) since 2026-11-11, so treat them with caution. This edition goes out before injury reports are final: we are waiting on Jayson Tatum and Derrick White for Boston, Tyrese Maxey for Philadelphia, P.J. Washington and Walter Clayton Jr. for Dallas, and OG Anunoby and Deni Avdija elsewhere, and morning searches turned up no fresh news on any of them.

cards.p|4251|reb|Under: The sim has him under in 82% of games and the projection is 3.7 against 5.5, with a blowout spot where he went under 17 of 21 times. The risk is minutes: he goes over when he plays long, and a change in Tatum or White's status would re-price the game, so pass if the line drops to 4.5 or the price goes past −106.
cards.p|4278049|reb|Under: He has averaged 4.2 rebounds over his last 10 and stayed under 6.5 in 8 of them, with a projection of 4.2 on 17.5 minutes. What makes it wrong is a bigger role: he averaged 25.9 minutes in his overs, and if P.J. Washington or Walter Clayton Jr. sits, the frontcourt minutes could grow against a LAC side that gives up +6% rebounds to power forwards.
cards.p|4845367|ra|Under: The projection of 10.4 sits well below 12.5, and the 16.5-pt spread adds blowout risk that cuts minutes. The case against is real: without Dylan Harper he went under 12.5 only 1 of 5 times, and Harper is out tonight, so this is the card most exposed to a bigger role.
cards.p|4684806|reb|Under: The sim has him under in 71% of games with a projection of 3.4, and he stayed under even 3.5 in 7 of his last 10. With Anthony Edwards, Cameron Boozer and Javon Small all out, rotations are thin, and he goes over when he plays long, so watch his minutes and Ty Jerome's status.
cards.p|3134907|ra|Under: This is a Pass at conviction 44: the sim is only 59% and the projection of 6.4 is close to the line of 6.5. His history against PHI argues against it (1 of 7 under 6.5), so the rest spot and blowout risk are not enough to lean on here.

narratives.leans_note: The game-line leans include NO +17.5 at 61% in sims vs 50% at DraftKings, but game lines are 15-33 (-19.57u) so far, so they stay leans, not bets.
